text_pointers.first_1500_characters:
Whereas, in my judgment, the public interest requires that Louis A. Simon, supervising architect of the Public Buildings Branch of the Procurement Division, Treasuiy Department, who was exempted from compulsory retirement for age for periods totaling two years by Executive Orders No. 7581 of March 19, 1937, and No. 7824 of February 25, 1938, be further exempted from such compulsory retirement for a period of one year:

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Louis A. Simon from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending May 31, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

The White House,

February 11, 1939.

Executive Order 8046—Exemption of Louis A. Simon From Compulsory Retirement for Age

Now, Therefore, by virtue of and pursuant to the authority vested in me by section 204 of the act of June 30, 1932, 47 Stat. 382, 404 (U.S.C., title 5, sec. 715a), I hereby further exempt the said Louis A. Simon from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year ending May 31, 1940.

FRANKLIN D. ROOSEVELT

The White House,

February 11, 1939.
